parameters.query: SELECT a.Au_id,a.Au_ActionDate,a.Au_Description,a.Au_TaskName,a.Au_Category,a.Au_UserID,u.u_name,u.u_loginid,u.u_email FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON a.Au_UserID=u.u_id WHERE a.Au_id > {{ $json.last_audit_id }} AND a.Au_TaskName IN ('MetaEntry','Meta Entry','MetaEdit','Meta Edit','MetaData Entry','MetaData Edit','Meta Delete') ORDER BY a.Au_id ASC;

INSERT INTO n8n_asset_change_tracker
(
    audit_id,
    asset_id,
    change_type,
    change_date,
    user_id,
    username,
    task_name,
    description,
    category
)
VALUES
(
    {{ $json.audit_id }},
    '{{ String($json.asset_id || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.change_type || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
    '{{ $json.change_date }}',
    {{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }},
    '{{ String($json.username || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.task_name || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.description || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.category || '').replace(/'/g,"''") }}'
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    audit_id = audit_id;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_asset_change_tracker (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    audit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    asset_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    asset_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    asset_type VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    hostname VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    serial_no VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    change_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    changed_field VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    old_value TEXT NULL,
    new_value TEXT NULL,
    change_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NULL,
    username VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    login_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    task_name VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    description TEXT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_audit_id (audit_id),
    KEY idx_asset_id (asset_id),
    KEY idx_change_date (change_date),
    KEY idx_change_type (change_type)
);
